
<!-- The following figures illustrate the Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS) for the actual soil site conditions of the project, in terms of spectral pseudo-accelerations  $S_a(T_n)$  for a 5% critical damping, and return periods from 100 to 10,000 years. -->

```{r echo=FALSE}
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
TR_TARGET <- c(100,475,1000,2000,2475,5000,10000)
UHS <- UHSTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="openquake" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1" & TR %in% TR_TARGET]
YMAX <- max(1.1*UHS[TR==max(TR_TARGET) & p==0.95]$Sa,na.rm=TRUE) |> round(1)
CAP <-  "Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS) in terms of spectral pseudo-accelerations  $S_a(T_n)$  for a 5% critical damping, representing return periods from 100 to 10,000 years. Spectral ordinates were obtained for soil site conditions with  $V_{s30}$ = %4d  m/s within a p=%s confidence level."
```



::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills }


#### p=50%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- 0.50
#| fig-cap: CAP  |> sprintf(Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)
#| label: fig-UHS.50.site.html


DATA <- UHS[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=paste0("TR= ",TR," yr"),Y=Sa,X=Tn)][order(X)]|> unique()

PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  point.size = 0.1,
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
  yAxis.max = YMAX,
  xAxis.legend="Tn [s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa [g]",
  group.legend="TR [yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```

#### p=95%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- 0.95
#| fig-cap: CAP  |> sprintf(Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)x
#| label: fig-UHS.95.site.html


DATA <- UHS[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=paste0("TR= ",TR," yr"),Y=Sa,X=Tn)][order(X)]|> unique()
YMAX <- max(1.2*DATA$Y,na.rm=TRUE) |> round(1)
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.max = YMAX,
  xAxis.legend="Tn [s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa [g]",
  group.legend="TR [yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```
